title: Batch a week of videos in one afternoon

slides.headline: Film a week of videos in one afternoon
slides.sub: A simple order of work that stops the daily scramble.

slides.headline: Pick five ideas first
slides.body: Write the five titles before you touch the camera. Deciding while filming is what eats the hours.

slides.headline: Film everything in one setup
slides.body: Same light, same shirt, same background. Change the topic, not the room.

slides.headline: Edit in a second block
slides.body: Cut all five back to back while the scripts are fresh. Do not mix filming and editing.

slides.after: Viewers only see the finished video. Posting on time matters more than filming on time.

slides.headline: Save this for your next filming day
slides.cta: Follow for a new workflow each week
